body:
WHAT
The desktop's black-box log can be read without the transcript.
- L-01 secrets: redact() hides a value when its key ENDS like a secret name (…key, …token, …secret, …password, …authorization, …cookie, …credential(s) — compared without case, _ or -: apiKey, x-api-key, sessionToken, clientSecret), when the key is env, or when a string VALUE looks like a credential (Bearer …, sk-/rk-/pk_live-style keys, ghp_/gho_, xox?-, AIza…). A name that only CONTAINS token or key (inputTokens, outputTokens, contextTokens, maxTokens, keyboard) is kept.
- L-02 valid JSON: long strings are shortened inside the object before JSON.stringify (first 1,000 characters, then "…[+N chars]"), arrays keep their first 100 items then one "…[+N items]" entry, so every line parses. The nesting cap rises from 4 to 12 (it guards recursion; size is now bounded by the shortening), so a question_request's options are no longer "[depth capped]".
- L-03 deltas: thinking_delta, text_delta and tool_output_delta frames are folded per tab into one line per run — a run ends at the next other frame of that tab, after one second, or at a flush — carrying the type, the tool id for output, deltas (count), chars, and the text (shortened like any string).
- L-04: a tool_call_finished line carries durationMs, measured in main from its tool_call_started. The file name is UTC and says so (desktop-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSSZ.log); line timestamps were already UTC ISO. A state-sync frame the renderer sends before its engine exists (set_deletion_guard, set_overdrive, set_compact_limit — re-sent on session start) is logged as ev "state-sync-skipped", not as a dropped write; a user action that cannot be written is still "engine-write-dropped".
- Routing: every tab-bound line (engine frames, frames written to the engine, spawn, kill, exit, stderr, drops) carries tab and is written to THAT tab's workspace log, created on first use. Lines with no tab go to the focused workspace's log as before. setLogWorkspace no longer throws away lines queued for the previous file.

WHY
Field test 2026-09-23, findings L-01…L-04. SENSITIVE_KEY_RE (/key|token|secret/i) hid every *Tokens figure; logEvent cut lines at 2,048 characters AFTER stringify (107 invalid lines in the field log, 14 of 20 task updates among them); 113,000 one-token delta lines buried the 12.8 MB log; tool lines had no duration, the file name was local time while lines were UTC; start-up noise read as engine-write-dropped. And one currentLogFile meant frames from a background tab's engine landed in the focused workspace's log with nothing saying which tab they came from.

WHERE
app/main/logging.js — redact(), logEvent(ch, data, target), logEngineFrame(event, target), flushLog(), setLogWorkspace(), formatTimestamp(). app/main.js — the tab-bound logEvent calls in stopEngine(), writeToEngine(), startEngine() pass { workspace, tabId }; the stdout pump calls logEngineFrame.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. (fs) redact keeps inputTokens / outputTokens / contextTokens / maxTokens and a key named keyboard, and hides apiKey, api_key, token, password, authorization, env, a nested secret five levels down, and a Bearer / sk- value under an innocent key.
2. (fs) A tool_call_started whose input holds a 50 KB string, and a 300-item array, are logged; every line of the file parses, the string ends with "…[+49000 chars]" and the array with "…[+200 items]". A question_request with options six levels deep keeps them.
3. (fs) 1,000 thinking_delta frames then a tool_call_started are logged as at most a few thinking_delta lines whose deltas sum to 1,000 and whose chars sum to the text's length, then the tool line.
4. (fs) tool_call_started, a pause, then tool_call_finished: the finished line carries durationMs no smaller than the pause.
5. (fs) With workspace A focused, a frame logged for tab 2 of workspace B lands in B's log with tab "tab2" and not in A's; re-setting the same focused workspace drops nothing queued; the file name ends in Z.log.
6. (ui) In the real app with two workspaces open and the second focused, a frame sent to the first tab's engine and that engine's reply are in the first workspace's log, tagged with its tab, and not in the second's.

ADDED 2026-09-24 (audit follow-up):
- (fs) A credential INSIDE a longer string (a Bash command's Authorization: Bearer, a .env Write, KEY=value, a URL password, JWT, AWS/GitHub/Anthropic/OpenRouter/Fireworks/HF/Groq key shapes) is replaced where it sits; the rest of the line stays readable; an ordinary command that only mentions tokens keeps every word.
- (fs) Two tabs streaming at once each fold into their own run in their own log; a tab's non-engine line closes that tab's run first; a run's marker counts exactly the characters left out.
- (fs) durationMs uses the engine's own at stamps when both frames carry them; the start map is bounded at 1,000 open calls.
- Tab-specific sys lines (env-written, connection-swapped, profile-applied, model-changed, vision-changed) go to that tab's workspace log; a workspace whose log folder cannot be made writes to the userData log, never another workspace's.
